id: \rWhat is it? I'm very busy with a Snorlax problem right now.
en: \rWhat is it? I'm very busy with a Snorlax problem right now.
it: \rChe c'è? Al momento sono molto impegnata con un problema di Snorlax.

id: \rA Snorlax is eating all our grapefruit.
en: \rA Snorlax is eating all our grapefruit.
it: \rUno Snorlax si sta mangiando tutti i nostri pompelmi.

id: \rWhat? You'll stop it for us? Very well, I'll tell the guard to let you try.
en: \rWhat? You'll stop it for us? Very well, I'll tell the guard to let you try.
it: \rCome? Lo fermerai tu per noi? Benissimo, dirò alla guardia di lasciarti provare.

id: \rSnorlax should be on the island to the east of us.
en: \rSnorlax should be on the island to the east of us.
it: \rSnorlax dovrebbe trovarsi sull'isola a est di qui.

id: \rSo you actually stopped Snorlax? Here, take this as thanks.
en: \rSo you actually stopped Snorlax? Here, take this as thanks.
it: \rQuindi hai davvero fermato Snorlax? Ecco, prendi questo come ringraziamento.

id: \rI have a lot of work to do to fix the problems that Snorlax caused.
en: \rI have a lot of work to do to fix the problems that Snorlax caused.
it: \rHo un sacco di lavoro da fare per sistemare i problemi causati da Snorlax.
